purpose: Verify fail-closed geospatial metadata, masking, spatial holdout, tiling, polygon, area, and metric plumbing with a small team-authored fixture.

prediction_rule.threshold_provenance: Thresholds were fixed for a synthetic code-path fixture; they were not fitted to a public or operational scene.

spatial_split.selection_provenance: Right-hand tiles were declared as holdout in the manifest before execution; the split verifies leakage-safe plumbing but is not evidence of learned-model generalization.

reference.creator: EcoGuard public benchmark maintainers
reference.method: Manually fixed binary labels with intentional false-positive and false-negative cases; labels are stored separately from scene bands.

demonstrates: strict offline CRS and affine geotransform contract validation
native projected pixel polygons and affine-determinant area accounting
nodata, cloud, and shadow exclusion before NDVI evaluation
acquisition timestamp and declared seasonality policy validation
deterministic clipped tiling and tile-level spatial holdout plumbing
reference provenance and valid-holdout-only binary metric accounting
does_not_demonstrate: real Sentinel or Landsat ingestion, calibration, atmospheric correction, cloud-mask quality, or co-registration
real-world forest-loss accuracy, learned-model generalization, or independent ground truth
geodetic reprojection or RFC 7946 WGS84 interchange
CNN, XAI, production-scale raster performance, field verification, or EUDR compliance
